finding location=drivers/net/wireless/marvell/mwifiex/uap_txrx.c:107-198 confidence=high conclusion=mwifiex AP-mode RX bridging saves rx_pkt_hdr/uap_rx_pd from skb->data, then skb_realloc_headroom+pskb_expand_head and kfree_skb free the old head, and lines 189/194-195/198 read freed memory (stale-pointer slab-UAF read, high confidence).
unresolved location=drivers/net/ppp/pppoe.c:450 conclusion=Follow up: determine whether a cloned, frag-backed PPPoE session frame can reach pppoe_rcv_core so pskb_trim_rcsum at pppoe.c:442 reallocates and ph->sid at 450 reads the freed head.
unresolved location=drivers/net/wireless/marvell/mwifiex/main.c:885 conclusion=Follow up: finish reading mwifiex main.c around line 885 to confirm no pre-realloc header pointer (e.g. from callers) is used after the kfree_skb of the old skb.
unresolved location=net/mac80211/rx.c:3874 conclusion=Follow up: read net/mac80211/rx.c 3780-3890 to check whether the hdr saved at 3785 is dereferenced after pskb_trim at 3874 and whether that skb can be cloned on the fast-RX path.
coverage_gap=net/mac80211 fast-RX hdr (rx.c:3785/3874), mwifiex main.c:885 TX path, and pppoe.c:442/450 were flagged but not read to a conclusion before the finalize limit; each carries a follow-up conclusion.
coverage_gap=Helpers used outside net/ and drivers/net/ (netfilter core under net/netfilter beyond grep hits, bluetooth, other driver trees) were only rank-counted, not audited; pskb_carve sites (11) were never read.
coverage_gap=Bare skb_trim() (not pskb_trim) call sites and plain 'ptr = skb->data + off' offsets were not systematically enumerated in this session.
limitation=The mwifiex finding is a source-reading hypothesis, not a reproduction: no KASAN build, crafted frame, or runtime harness was run against the read-only snapshot; the head free is inferred from skb_realloc_headroom's skb_clone+pskb_expand_head path (net/core/skbuff.c:1274-1290) and the unconditional kfree_skb(skb) at uap_txrx.c:176.
limitation=Triggering the mwifiex stale reads requires skb_headroom(skb) < MWIFIEX_MIN_DATA_HEADER_LEN after the hdr_chop pull, which depends on mwifiex RX skb allocation headroom (SDIO/USB/PCIE allocation paths) and on firmware-controlled rx_pkt_offset/rx_pkt_length within the checked bound at uap_txrx.c:390-391; if driver allocations always leave enough headroom the path is latent.
limitation=The attacker influence is the 802.11 station (or malicious firmware) sending frames to the mwifiex-hosted AP interface; the values read through the dangling pointers (h_source/h_dest/rx_rate/ht_info) are informational, so impact is a slab-use-after-free read (memory disclosure/stale-value use) and potential crash, not a write.
limitation=Line numbers are valid only for the supplied snapshots/s02 tree (revision opaque, no git history or network access permitted), so upstream fix status could not be checked; net/phonet/pep.c pep_get_sb was excluded by instruction and never treated as a report target.
limitation=The function-extent scanner matches single-line assignments and named accessors only, so multi-line pointer derivations, pointers passed into helper functions, and macro accessors outside the literal regex may have been missed among the several hundred raw call sites.
